headline: J8 frontier (dev): all named arms have ≥114 rows. Headline quality contrast uses all-episodes (crash = 0) for every metric; survivor population is reported alongside.
oracle_semantics: oracle semantics: runs free  (src/sidekick/runner.py:297; src/sidekick/systems/loop.py:627; src/sidekick/systems/loop.py:731; src/sidekick/systems/oracle_escalation.py:9-18; configs/hj8_oracle_escalation.yaml:37-38)
planner_calls_definition: planner_calls_per_episode is the mean of ledger live totals.planner_calls_total; planner_calls_replay_inclusive_per_episode is the mean of RunResult.n_planner_calls. The live count is never silently replaced by the replay count.

choice.reason: missing calls/episode on the arm or on every fixed_k arm

h3_populations: scored is the primary H3 population: ticks at or before the episode's final step (decision points that existed). grid retains the published 5,10,...,40 tick grid, including post-episode filler scored as 0.0. Headline H3 uses scored.
population_preamble: Headline quality contrast uses all-episodes for every metric (crashed episode scores 0). Survivor columns/contrasts use episodes with error_type != 'crash'; a paired survivor contrast drops a (task_id, seed) pair if either side crashed.
